internal.title: Incident Summary: Kafka Consumer Lag High in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 11:17 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered for the accounting service. The investigation identified three supported hypotheses: an error injection in the checkout service causing a 40% error rate, high latency and elevated error rate in the accounting service itself, and a significant backlog in Kafka consumer lag for accounting. Multiple diagnosis rounds were conducted, but proposed remediation actions such as restarting the accounting service were not feasible due to deployment constraints and guardrail refusals. The incident was escalated for further handling.

Impact: Customers may have experienced delays or errors in accounting-related operations due to processing backlogs and service latency.

Next steps include further escalation and investigation to identify a viable remediation path and prevent recurrence.

external.body: On 2026-11-08 starting at 11:17 UTC, some customers experienced intermittent delays in processing accounting-related transactions. Our monitoring detected a backlog in message processing which caused slower response times. We are actively investigating the root cause and working to restore normal service as quickly as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience.
